name: MC30S
tagline: Four-port 2.5GbE appliance with DDR4 and DDR5 configurations
description: Compare DDR4 and DDR5 CPU platforms in the MC30S enclosure. Both configurations provide four Intel i226 2.5GbE ports, HDMI and DisplayPort, RJ45 COM, NVMe and SATA storage. CPU, memory and TDP follow the selected configuration.

specs.label: Graphics
specs.value: Integrated Intel graphics; exact GPU depends on the selected CPU

specs.label: Display
specs.value: 1 x DP port; 1 x HDMI port

specs.label: Power
specs.value: DC 12 V / 4 A, 5.5 x 2.5 mm jack

specs.label: Expansion
specs.value: 1 x Mini PCIe for Wi-Fi / Bluetooth / 4G; 1 x M.2 2242 for 5G

specs.label: Front I/O
specs.value: Power input; 4 x 2.5 GbE; RJ45 COM; power / HDD LEDs

specs.label: Rear I/O
specs.value: 2 x USB 3.0; 2 x USB 2.0; HDMI; DP; power; CLR-CMOS; 4G/5G SIM
